Project.title: Project
Project.description: An AI-generated web application project created by a user in Craftable.

userId.description: UID of the owning Firebase Auth user.

title.description: Display title of the generated project.

initialPrompt.description: Original prompt that created the project.

templateType.description: Category/template style for the generated application.

isStarred.description: Whether the project is starred by the user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the project was created (written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the project was last updated (written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: A prompt or AI builder response message inside a project conversation.

userId.description: UID of the owning Firebase Auth user.

role.description: Sender role in the builder conversation.

content.description: Message text or AI build summary.

filesChanged.description: Bounded list of filenames updated in this turn.

versionTag.description: Project version number associated with this message.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the message was created (written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/projects/{projectId}.description: User-scoped Craftable projects storing generated HTML/CSS/JS bundles and metadata.

/users/{userId}/projects/{projectId}/mes.description: Conversation history of user prompts and AI build turns for a project.
